other_failure_modes.name: LightGBM Multiclass Prediction Shape Mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: For multiclass tasks, LightGBM's predict method returns class probabilities of shape (n_samples, n_classes), not flat labels. The code incorrectly attempts to cast these probability arrays directly to integers via a list comprehension without using argmax, which will cause a TypeError.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing Target Label Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: LightGBM requires multiclass targets to be encoded strictly as integers from 0 to num_classes - 1. If the target column contains strings or non-contiguous integers, the model will crash with a fatal error (as evidenced by the process log).

other_failure_modes.name: Misleading CV Score Print
other_failure_modes.description: The code prints the accuracy of only the final fold while labeling it as the '5-fold CV Accuracy', which is misleading before it subsequently prints the actual mean.

summary: The agent sets up a basic 5-fold CV loop with LightGBM but skips all data cleaning and feature engineering. Crucially, the solution contains execution-halting bugs: it fails to encode the multiclass target properly for LightGBM and attempts to directly cast the model's output multiclass probabilities to integers without taking the argmax.
